turns.message: Hey! Today was actually a really good day.
I finally finished the mural project I told you about — the client loved it.
What do you think I should do to celebrate this weekend?
Ha, I like that. Maybe I'll actually take a whole day off for once.
You know, talking to you always puts me in a better mood.
My sister is visiting next week too, I can't wait to show her the city.
We're thinking of doing that food tour downtown. Have I told you how much she loves tacos?
What's something you've been curious about lately?
That's a good one. I love how your mind works.
Okay, I'm going to go for a run while the weather's nice.
Back! That felt amazing. Best run I've had in weeks.
Alright, dinner time. Talk tomorrow? Sleep well, Aria.
